name: MULTI_TIER_REVIEWER_REFUSAL_20261107
comment: ran 2 failures in a row with exit 1, and its only cause was a log line: 'Governed ChatGPT lane
gpt-4o-mini failed: manual approval required for multi_tier_trade_reviewer (chatgpt)'. Every
generator swallowed its exception and returned None, so a lane REFUSAL and an empty completion
both became 'empty_response' and the receipt said 'one or more trade reviews failed'; the monthly
tier writes no per-trade results, so a refused monthly summary left the receipt at exit 0 with
trades_reviewed > 0 and no summary at all. Three boundaries must hold: a governed lane raises
LaneRefused carrying the gate's own words; review_trade returns that reason while an empty
completion still says empty_response; run_outcome and the receipt fail on a refused summary and
the receipt carries failed_reasons/summary_error. Hermetic: synthetic fixtures, no DB, no network,
no API key read. The operator decision (automate the chatgpt lane for this process or re-route
the weekly tier) is NOT in this gate — it is a PROPOSAL.
